market_question: Will the UK designate the IRGC a terrorist organization by June 30?
reasoning: The market implies only a 6.5% probability of UK designating the IRGC by mid-2026. A Labour government is likely after the upcoming general election, and senior Labour figures have previously called for proscription. Recent IRGC-linked plots on UK soil add momentum, outweighing the current government’s diplomatic caution. I assess a ~20% chance, significantly above market pricing.
evidence_points: The UK government has so far declined to proscribe the IRGC despite years of pressure from MPs and allies.
Shadow Foreign Secretary David Lammy and other Labour leaders have publicly backed proscription, signaling a policy shift under a likely Labour government.
Multiple Iran-linked threats and assassination plots in the UK have intensified calls for a formal terrorist designation.
